# Holdout run rows stay private: numbers are published, replies are not
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #113, sha256:dbf08ca657f05db1952ce0a7547cd71a27e1c4c24d441e9d016bae4eb37c84cf). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** feature (thin slice; benchmark storage)
- **Milestone:** Measure first: does Phrase beat plain C# on tokens and attempts at an equal or better pass rate?
- **Source:** Slicing of card 102 (record R2, 2026-10-27): the holdouts are unsealed, valid and endpoint tasks, and both arms can now score endpoint outcomes (cards 110, 111), but nothing yet turns a holdout file into the two arms' task folders, and the stored result rows would put model replies derived from sealed tasks into the PUBLIC repository history. The frozen bar (D32) and the same-level rule (D37) are unchanged.
- **Depends on:** 111
- **Story:** As Steve, I want the holdout run to store its rows outside the public repository and publish only the numbers, so that the sealed tasks and the replies they produced never appear in public history.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a benchmark run with a private results path option, When it runs, Then rows are appended to that path and not to bench/results/history.jsonl, and the default run is unchanged
  2. Given the private rows, When a summary is produced, Then the summary file contains per arm, model and kind only pass rate, attempts, tokens and counts (no task text, no reply text, no reply_head, no task ids beyond H1 to H3) and a test fails if any reply text appears
  3. Given the repository check scripts, When they run, Then a check fails if a path under bench/holdouts-unsealed or a row labelled holdout appears in a tracked file

## Context

- The repository is PUBLIC. The holdout files, the task folders made from them, their prompts and any model reply to them must NEVER be committed or pushed: they live under bench/holdouts-unsealed/ (git-ignored). Tests use an INVENTED file in the holdout format, never the real holdouts.
- Applies to both tools/Phrase.Bench and tools/Phrase.BenchCs.
